title: Remote-ahead restart contract
summary: Implemented a runner recovery contract for `remote_ahead`: daily runs remain blocked when the remote main baseline advances, but the run summary now returns `next_action.kind:"restart_latest_main"` with an explicit `npm run daily:run -- --date YYYY-MM-DD --restart` command instead of a generic stage-inspection action.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "daily runner turns remote ahead publish dry-run into restart latest main action" tests/unit.test.js

node --test --test-name-pattern "daily resilience policy validates current runner stages and workflow gates|daily runner writes launcher summary and stops before real publish by default|daily runner turns remote ahead publish dry-run into restart latest main action" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: A `remote_ahead` block is a stale-baseline recovery problem, not a content degradation or GitHub API fallback problem.
lessons.evidence: The focused red test initially returned `inspect_stage_failure`; after the fix, `publish_dry_run_daily` produces `restart_latest_main` while keeping `final_status:"blocked"`.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep `remote_ahead` recovery tied to regenerating from current `origin/main` rather than reusing stale artifacts.

lessons.lesson: Parallel agent work makes stale-baseline blocks more likely even when every earlier generation and validation stage passes.
lessons.evidence: The traced 2026-06-26 run completed quality repair, build, page check, validation, and source audit, then stopped only because `origin/main` advanced before publish dry-run.
lessons.recommended_action: After this slice, prioritize a clean-build reproducibility gate and keep Claude-owned quality-loop/trends work out of this branch.

suggestions.issue: Daily runs that hit `remote_ahead` ended with a generic action, forcing the operator to infer that the correct recovery was a fresh latest-main run.
suggestions.evidence: The new runner test asserts `next_action.kind:"restart_latest_main"`, `remote.remoteAhead`, the clean repo root, and the restart command.
suggestions.suggestion: Classify `remote_ahead` as an explicit restart-from-latest-main action in the runner summary and resilience policy.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Manual and scheduled operators get a deterministic next step, reducing wasted reruns and avoiding unsafe fallback publish attempts.
validation_evidence: node --test --test-name-pattern "daily runner turns remote ahead publish dry-run into restart latest main action" tests/unit.test.js

followups.action: Add a clean-build reproducibility gate so `npm run build` cannot rewrite historical `docs/reports` artifacts without an explicit fixture/update path.
Diagnose Hugging Face, WeChat, and Zhihu source-lane health with live/source-specific checks after runner recovery is merged.
Wait for Claude Code's trends and generation-first authoring branch before implementing GitHub Trending API enrichment or curated X handles.
